% A revtex4 article for aps, without hyperref, with a single appendix
% from \appendix*. revtex4 sets \thesection to \unskip there, which
% tex4ht wrote into the anchor of the next section, and the next run
% stopped on it. In the PDF each section after \appendix* starts with
% "Appendix:" and has no number, a \ref to it is empty, and its
% equations are numbered A.1. A section with no title is "Appendix"
% alone, and a starred section has no label. A subsection's \ref is its
% number alone, and a \label in a section's title gives an empty \ref.
\documentclass{revtex4}
\begin{document}
\title{Revfour appendix}
\author{Someone}
\begin{abstract}
Text of the abstract.
\end{abstract}
\maketitle
\section{First section}\label{sec:first}
Text of the first section, before appendix~[\ref{app:math}] and
Eq.~(\ref{eq:app}).
\appendix*
\section{Mass $m$ and \emph{energy}}\label{app:math}
Text of the appendix with math.
\begin{equation}
E = m c^2 \label{eq:app}
\end{equation}
Text after Eq.~(\ref{eq:app}), and back to appendix~[\ref{app:math}].
\subsection{A subsection}\label{app:sub}
Text of the appendix's subsection, see subsection~[\ref{app:sub}].
\section[Short]{Long title of an appendix}
Text of the long appendix.
\section{}
Text of the bare appendix.
\section{Details\label{app:in}}
Text of the details, see details~[\ref{app:in}].
\section*{Starred tail}
Text of the starred tail.
\end{document}
